camel_example: aliyun gpdb CreateSecret --region cn-hangzhou --Username testacc --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Password pwd123
description_en: Creates a credential for accessing an instance by using a username and password
description_zh: 通过用户名密码创建访问实例的凭证
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-secret --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --username testacc --password pwd123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSecret

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including the instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple database instances. This parameter and the DBInstanceId parameter cannot be left empty at the same time. If both parameters are specified, this parameter takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The username for database access.

Limits:
The username can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must start with a lowercase letter.
The username can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库访问用户名。

限制：
由小写字母，数字，下划线组成，并且以小写字母开头。
长度不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The description of the credential. The description can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 凭据的描述信息。长度不能超过255个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the credential. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 16 characters in length. If this parameter is left empty, the value of the Username parameter is used as the secret name
parameters.help_zh: 凭据名称。由字母、数字和下划线组成，长度为1-16个字符。为空时则使用Username参数作为SecretName
parameters.name: secret_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to test the instance connection by using the username and password
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过用户名和密码检测实例链接是否正常
parameters.name: test_connection

Message.description_en: The detailed information returned by the operation

SecretArn.description_en:
The ARN that uniquely identifies the logon credential and permissions of the Data API account created by the user.
Format: ```acs:gpdb:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:secret/{{secretName}}-{{32 digits random string}}```
SecretArn.description_zh:
唯一指定用户创建的Data API账号的登录凭证及权限。
格式如下：```acs:gpdb:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:secret/{{secretName}}-{{32 digits random string}```

Status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:

success: The operation is successful.
fail: The operation failed
Status.description_zh:
状态，取值如下：

success：成功。
fail：失败
